fields.name: count
fields.description: Amount of products for which the values in a field fall into the specified range

fields.name: from
fields.description: The range’s lower endpoint in number format

fields.name: fromStr
fields.description: The range’s lower endpoint in string format, empty string represents infinity

fields.name: includeFrom
fields.description: The flag indicates that From exclusive

fields.name: includeTo
fields.description: The flag indicates that To exclusive

fields.name: max
fields.description: Maximum value among all values contained within the range

fields.name: min
fields.description: Minimum value among all values contained within the range

fields.name: to
fields.description: The range’s upper endpoint in number format

fields.name: toStr
fields.description: The range’s upper endpoint in string format, empty string represents infinity

fields.name: total
fields.description: Sum of all values contained in the range
